senses.gloss:
लुट् I. €1 Ā. (लोटते)
—1 To resist, repel, oppose.
—2 To shine.
—3 To suffer pain. ━II. €10 U. (लोटयति-ते)
—1 To speak.
—2 To shine. ━III. €1. €4 P. (लोटति-लुट्यति)
—1 To roll, wallow on the ground; cf. लुठ्.
—2 To take away, rob, plunder (perhaps for लुण्ठ् or लुण्ट्).

लुट् A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the First or Periphrastic
 Future or its terminations.
